channel.title: titra: help articles
channel.description: titra is a GLP-1 dose tracker for iPhone and Android, made by AgentM: it records the doses, weights and side effects you log, and never gives dosing or medical advice.

item.title: What is free in titra and what titra+ adds
item.description: Logging, reminders, the site map, the timeline and CSV export are free in titra. titra+ adds insights, weight import, a PDF summary and cloud backup.

item.title: How titra dose reminders work
item.description: titra times each reminder from the dose you last logged, keeps reminding after a missed dose, and hides the medication name on the lock screen by default.

item.title: How the injection-site map works in titra
item.description: titra's body map records where each injection went, marks your last two sites and a suggested next one, and zooms in to a grid for the exact spot.

item.title: Your titra data: where it lives, export, delete
item.description: Where titra stores your log, what cloud backup uploads and when, how to export it as CSV, and what Delete all data and Delete account each remove.
